visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white T-shirt stands in front of a very large, bright circular ring light that creates a halo effect around his head. He smiles and speaks directly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. The background is a professional studio setting with some dark equipment visible on the sides. (2) The camera pans and tilts down to reveal a tabletop setup. There is a small circular makeup mirror on the left, a bright rectangular light panel in the center, and a smartphone mounted on a small tripod to the right acting as a monitor. The man's hand enters the frame, pointing at the equipment. (3) The camera moves to show a professional Canon DSLR camera mounted on a large tripod with several cables attached. The lighting remains bright and even across all objects. (4) The shot shifts to a wide view of a massive overhead light softbox shaped like a large dome. The man's hand gestures towards it, showing the scale of the lighting equipment. (5) The man is back in a medium close-up, talking and smiling. He raises his hand to wave or gesture as he speaks. (6) The camera focuses on a small black Vornado desk fan positioned next to the makeup mirror. The man's finger presses a button on the fan. (7) A mirror reflection shot shows the man holding his smartphone (an iPhone) to film the mirror, revealing the phone's back and his own reflection. (8) The final shot returns to a close-up of the man's face. He touches his hair and gestures towards the top of his head while smiling and winking at the camera. The ring light background persists throughout.
